title: Companies Planning To Increase Automation Investments Due To COVID-19, Honeywell Study Shows
主要内容: A Honeywell study indicates that over half of U.S. companies plan to increase automation investments due to the impact of the COVID-19 pandemic. The e-commerce, grocery, food and beverage, and logistics industries are most willing to invest more in automation. The study highlights the growing demand for automation solutions to improve speed, accuracy, and productivity in order processing and delivery. Warehouse execution software, order picking technology, and robotic solutions are expected to receive further investment. While automation is essential for business success, less than one-third of companies have scaled these solutions. Cost is the largest barrier to further investment, with over half of the consumer-packaged goods industry citing implementation costs as a major obstacle. Companies are investing in automation to improve safety and operational efficiency, with scalable solutions offering immediate returns at lower costs. Honeywell Intelligrated provides integrated automation solutions to help companies optimize their fulfillment processes.
